reviews.comment: It's an average upper-level literature class. The subject changes each semester, but she is a great prof all things considered. She will critique your work in a way that is helpful to your future in writing essays. Do NOT forget to participate.
reviews.ratingTags: Get ready to read--So many papers--Lecture heavy

reviews.comment: TAKE! THIS! CLASS! Prof Egenolf is the nicest, most chill prof I've ever had. We read about 3-4 short stories a week and have a reading check quiz at the end of each week. Super easy. There are 2 tests that are short answer/essay but so easy if you read!! Genuinely recommend this to anyone who needs a lit credit!!

Dr. Egenolf is a great professor and her class is a breeze when you listen and take notes, she basically gives you the answer. She took the time to learn everyone's name never tells a student they are giving a wrong answer. She does do pop quizzes, but 30% of the grade is being in class. She also is very knowledgable about what she is teaching.
reviews.ratingTags: Get ready to read--Beware of pop quizzes--Caring

reviews.comment: Not sure what to think of her. She seems like a good professor, but the amount of work you must do for a 200-level course is astonishing. I love literature and the arts and have taken 300 and 400-level courses, which seemed to have a better course load and a more coherent syllabus. Take her at your own risk. Passive aggressive, and condescending.
reviews.ratingTags: Tough grader--Beware of pop quizzes--So many papers

reviews.comment: I am unsure how she managed to be rated as good as she is here. However, she is wholly unprepared to be a professor. 1) Tough grader, will mark off for the slightest error. 2) Course planning is abysmal which leads her to seem magnanimous with her extensions. 3) Don't believe this, look at her grade distribution on Texas A&M grade distribution.
reviews.ratingTags: Tough grader--Beware of pop quizzes--So many papers

reviews.comment: Dr. Egenolf is a good professor but the class requires way too much work for an english elective. There are readings due every class and pop quizzes over the readings (she notifies you a class before). She is very lenient on due dates and offers lots of extensions, but there are a lot of papers too so be ready for that.
reviews.ratingTags: Participation matters--Lots of homework--Beware of pop quizzes

reviews.comment: Dr. Egenolf is so genuinely so caring and funny and will give you an extension on pretty much ANYTHING if you ask her in advance, and she's very understanding towards participation. The only thing is that she grades very slowly and you will not know what you're making until the last week. A lot of reading but all the books are interesting!

Pop quizzes. A lot of required reading for a lower level course. Had 2 novels, and short stories to read. Novels had to be read within a week with other classes (annoying) and other short stories along with it. Midterm and a final, all handwritten. Quote identifications from the readings and an essay. She does give a notecard for the tests.
reviews.ratingTags: Tough Grader--Skip class? You won't pass.--BEWARE OF POP QUIZZES

reviews.comment: This class is not difficult to get an A or B. If you complete the readings and come to class, it is really difficult not to do OK. Egenolf is confusing about requirements for projects sometimes; for in-class work she doesn't grade harshly. She is slow to grade papers, for help, go to her office hours. If you don't mind reading, take this class
reviews.ratingTags: Get ready to read--BEWARE OF POP QUIZZES

reviews.comment: Don't take her class!I'm in it right now and I am heavily considering Q dropping. I have a low B in the class right now, I want to Q drop because of her teaching style and grading. Tough grader, condescending, rude at times. The amount of time and attention this class requires is not worth it. Quizzes every week. Too much work for& a bad prof!!
reviews.ratingTags: Tough Grader--Get ready to read--BEWARE OF POP QUIZZES

reviews.comment: There are pop quizzes almost every class period, so you must read. Sparknotes won't help much. There are only 2 exams: the midterm and the final. Nothing is multiple choice. Dr. Egenolf is sometimes condescending, as when I asked a question, she literally told me, "I don't how how to make this more clear to you." I would not recommend.
reviews.ratingTags: Tough Grader--Get ready to read--Skip class? You won't pass.

reviews.comment: Dr. Egenolf is approachable and is really passionate about her research.  Unfortunately she doesn't have clear guidelines for the papers she wants you to write and grades sort of harsh.  She says to write over your opinion, then will disagree with you and mark off for it.  A little confusing at times.
reviews.ratingTags: Tough Grader--Get ready to read--SO MANY PAPERS

reviews.comment: I really enjoyed this prof. She is really nice and funny, the workload is a lot because we have about 4 novels to read and in a short amount of time. We have random pop quizzes, and she takes attendance every day. I would take her again because of how nice she was.
reviews.ratingTags: Skip class? You won't pass.--BEWARE OF POP QUIZZES--Caring

reviews.comment: Dr. Egenolf is very passionate about her subject. Her class consists of daily discussions on assigned readings, a few quizzes, and 3 big papers that allow for rewrites/revisions. She genuinely wants to hear your perspective and encourages you to think analytically about everything you read. She cares about her students.
reviews.ratingTags: Get ready to read--Participation matters--LECTURE HEAVY

reviews.comment: Pretty straight forward class. Read and talk about what was read. Midterm and final. One big project. Many quizzes over the readings. Sometimes she gives notice, sometimes she doesn't. Must have read reading to do well on quiz (no sparknotes).

I would not recommend her at all. It is very confusing on what she is asking for when it comes to projects. Doesn't use any visual aids and doesn't seem organized. She's a nice lady and is approachable, but her grading is horrible. Basically if she doesn't like it then you won't get a good grade. C is possible if you try hard. I got a 69 no curve.
